name: OMTArchy - NYC Subway MTA
author: tirade
description: Next NYC subway arrivals for a station, live from the MTA's GTFS-realtime feed

barWidget.description: Next arrivals at a subway station, in the bar and in a detail popup. Tap "Change" in the popup to search or browse by line for a station.

schema.label: Line group
schema.description: Which MTA GTFS-realtime feed to poll. Set automatically when you pick a station with "Change" in the popup; only matters here if you're typing a Stop ID by hand below.

schema.label: Stop ID
schema.description: GTFS stop_id for the station. Normally set for you by the in-popup station picker (search by name or browse by line) — this field is a manual fallback for a stop_id the picker doesn't have. Can be a comma-separated list of stop_ids sharing one feed, to track a whole multi-line complex (e.g. Grand Central's 4/5/6, 7, and S platforms) as a single board — set automatically when you click a station row instead of one of its line pills.

schema.label: Direction
schema.description: both shows an Uptown/Downtown toggle in the popup. N or S locks the popup to just that direction (N = uptown/northbound, S = downtown/southbound).

schema.label: Routes (optional)
schema.description: Comma-separated route IDs to fetch, e.g. 1,2,3. Blank fetches every route serving this stop; tap a route's pill in the popup to focus on just that line.

schema.label: Arrivals shown
schema.description: How many upcoming trains to list for the selected direction/route.

schema.label: Refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: MTA feeds update roughly every 30s; polling faster than that just burns CPU.

schema.label: Bar label override
schema.description: Short name shown in the bar, e.g. Times Sq. Defaults to the stop ID.
